title: Relationship Pricing Note — Operating Credit Discount on the FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage (Farm Real Estate Loans)
content:
A member's operating credit with the association earns a relationship discount in the rate of a FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage (Farm Real Estate Loans) set when automatic debit is authorised. The relationship discount follows the member's operating credit with the association — the member's Operating Lines of Credit: a member holding an operating line in active status that is collected by AutoDraft receives the same relationship discount that operating product grants, but never less than 0.10 percentage points; a member holding an operating line in active status that is not on AutoDraft receives 0.05 percentage points; any other member receives none.

**What the records show.** The member's Operating Lines of Credit records: each line's status (active, or another status), whether it is enrolled in AutoDraft, and the line's product, whose schedule states the relationship rate discount that product grants.

## Discount ladder

| Member's operating credit | Relationship discount (percentage points) |
|---|---|
| An operating line in active status collected by AutoDraft | the relationship discount that line's operating product grants, but not less than 0.10 |
| An operating line in active status not on AutoDraft | 0.05 |
| No operating line in active status | none |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

| Active operating line | On AutoDraft | Relationship discount granted by that operating product | Discount here |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 0.125 | 0.125 |
| yes | yes | 0.08 | 0.10 (never less than 0.10) |
| yes | no | any | 0.05 |
| none (only a matured or suspended line) | — | — | none |
